name: genpark-enterprise-identity-token-exchange-bridge-skill
description: Enterprise Cross-System Identity & Token Exchange Bridge (inspired by WeChat Work, Tencent Cloud OAuth2 & WorkBuddy Delegated Execution). Safely manages on-behalf-of token exchange, scoped permission delegation, token lifetime refresh, and zero-leakage ephemeral credentials.

tools.name: exchange_enterprise_identity_token
tools.description: Enterprise identity token exchange: issue on-behalf-of delegated tokens, validate scope boundaries, refresh expired tokens, and revoke credentials.

target_service.description: Destination enterprise service (e.g. TENCENT_DOCS, PAYROLL, GIT).

token_string.description: Delegated token string to validate or refresh.
